POSFIX

Privacy Notice

Last updated: 28 September 2026

This notice explains how [Company name] ([Registration no.]), the provider of POSFIX ("we", "us"), handles personal data, as required by the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).

1. Whose data, and our role

  • Shop owners — we collect and use this data ourselves, to run your account and subscription.
  • Staff, and the shop's customers and suppliers — the shop keys this data in and decides what it is used for. We store and process it for the shop, only to provide POSFIX. Questions about it should go to the shop first.

2. What we collect

  • Shop owner: name and email from the Google account or email sign-in, the shop's name, address, phone and business details, and payment slips and payment records for the subscription.
  • Staff: name, PIN (stored protected, never shown), and which device each person uses.
  • Customers of the shop: name, phone number, what was bought or repaired, warranty, device details and condition notes or photos the shop records, and points balance.
  • Suppliers of the shop: name, bank details and invoices the shop records.
  • Technical data: the device, browser and app version, and error reports when something goes wrong in the app, so we can fix it. Error reports are kept for 30 days.
  • Voice AI: when the shop owner uses the microphone to key in Money Out, short recordings of what they say are sent to be understood and turned into the form's fields. We do not keep the recordings.

3. Why we use it

  • To provide POSFIX: sign-in, recording and syncing a shop's records across its devices, receipts, job tickets and repair tracking.
  • To manage subscriptions and check payments.
  • To keep the service secure and working, and to fix faults.
  • To contact the shop owner about the account, the subscription or the service.

We do not sell personal data, and we do not use a shop's customer data for our own marketing.

4. Who can see it

  • The shop's owner, and its staff on the shop's devices.
  • Anyone holding a receipt, job ticket or repair-tracking link the shop has sent. Each link carries a long random code that cannot be guessed.
  • Our service providers: Google Cloud / Firebase (hosting, database, file storage and sign-in), which store the data on our behalf, and Google Gemini, which understands Voice AI recordings. The data may be stored or processed on servers outside Malaysia.
  • Authorities, where the law requires it.

5. How long we keep it

A shop's records are kept while the shop exists, including while it is locked for an unpaid subscription, so nothing is lost when it is renewed. Error reports are deleted after 30 days. When a shop asks us to close it and delete its data, we do so, except for payment records we must keep by law.

6. Security

Every shop's data is kept separate from every other shop's, and access is checked on our servers for every read and write. Connections are encrypted. Payment slips can be seen only by the shop owner and by us.

7. Your choices and rights

Under the PDPA you may ask to see, correct or limit the use of your personal data, and you may withdraw consent. A shop owner can correct most details directly in the admin app and export the shop's records. For customers and staff of a shop, please ask the shop; we will help the shop respond. Some requests may mean the service can no longer be provided.

8. Is it required?

The shop owner's sign-in details are needed to create and run a shop. Without them POSFIX cannot be provided.

9. Changes and contact

We may update this notice; the date at the top shows the latest version. For any question or request about personal data: [Company name], [Address]. Email: [Email].
